_meta.note: Pre-market screen edited by day-screener. ORB levels fill in live 9:45-9:50 AM ET. Dropped PFE (tiny ATR, no catalyst) and BAC (tiny ATR, flat post-earnings). Ranked by opportunity: gap magnitude x ATR x liquidity.

NVDA.note: gapped +7.4% (+$15.02) on CPI relief rally and semiconductor sector recovery after yesterday's broad semi selloff; highest liquidity on the list (5.24M avg vol); primary setup: ORB breakout above premarket high $218.51 or VWAP reclaim after morning shakeout; support at $215 round number; resistance at $220 round number; extreme downside pivot (gap fill) at $203.49 — if price trades back there, the thesis is broken; sizing: risk $250/trade, ATR stop 1.5x$6.85=$10.28, entry ~$218 implies ~24 shares (~$5,200 deployed); skip if semiconductor sector shows renewed selling or spread is above 25bp at open

INTC.note: gapped +5.1% (+$5.22) on same CPI/semi-recovery catalyst as NVDA; ATR $9.95 is the highest on today's list — signals large expected daily swings but demands very small sizing (risk $250/trade, stop 1.5x$9.95=$14.93 implies ~17 shares ~$1,840 deployed); setup: ORB breakout above premarket high $108.25 or VWAP reclaim; resistance at $110 (psychological and near pre-selloff range from July 12); support at $105 round; gap fill at $103.03 is the hard downside pivot; yesterday INTC had a sector-level disarm — confirm the sector is genuinely recovering (NVDA holding gains, volume on semis elevated) before treating INTC as armed; skip if relative volume is below 1.2x or spread exceeds 25bp at open

AMZN.note: flat gap (-0.6%, -$1.51) — no independent catalyst today; kept because ATR $7.38 gives viable ORB range on a high-event macro day; on a benign CPI tape the broad market may carry AMZN upward; prev close $247.32 acts as both resistance and the gap-fill target — a long that fills the gap and holds $247.32 becomes support sets up a possible continuation; support at $245 round number near current premarket; only trade if broad market direction is confirmed clear after CPI reaction and Warsh testimony (10 AM ET); skip if no directional conviction in first 30 minutes or spread above 25bp

NFLX.note: minor gap down (-1.2%, -$0.91) with Q2 earnings Thursday Jul 16 after close (2 days away); pre-earnings positioning can create intraday drift in either direction; was the only armed name yesterday and showed relative strength; gap fill to prev close $73.86 is the natural long target; support at $72.00 round number; ATR $2.43 is the smallest on the kept list — limits profit potential, so size conservatively (risk $250/trade, stop 1.5x$2.43=$3.65 implies ~68 shares ~$4,960 deployed — check that stop is not wider than realistic intraday range); reduce to half-size if pre-earnings jitter is visible in tape; skip entirely if spread exceeds 25bp at open, if broad market is negative, or if price breaks below $72 in the first 15 minutes
